scientific_reason: C077-A development identities inherit the C071 threshold-8 prior-history gate. The external source has result identities rather than the original complete-stats provider, so the transport confirmation freezes the closest auditable zero-label analogue before score values are opened: both teams must each have at least 8 prior completed fixture identities strictly before the target calendar date.

eligibility.history_population: all frozen completed source identities, regardless of later realized total goals
eligibility.strict_pit: only identities on calendar dates strictly earlier than target date count
eligibility.same_day_rule: all same-date fixtures are assessed from the history state at the start of that date; all same-date identities update history only after all eligibility decisions for that date are frozen

stopping_rule: If the zero-label eligible identity population is too small to plausibly support the frozen confirmation coverage gate, stop before numeric score access. Do not lower the 8-match history requirement after viewing any score value.
